# TS02-C3 — Stage-2 client orchestration — acquisition pools

## What it is for

The client surface for the whole acquisition family: pools, scores, anchors, distributors, delegation and vacating.

Talos is the only supported client path and the only gas-funded one. See `10-architecture/01-the-layer-cake.md`.

## Where it sits

Above the ten-module acquisition family. The largest Talos module by entrypoint count.

## Traps

**Vacating is exposed under the pool prefix**, not a prefix of its own, so an integrator looking for a vacate namespace will not find one.

**Claims are free but injections are not**, and injection cost scales with the number of *members*, not stakers.
